name: American Plastic Molds
old_description: American Plastic Molds is a plastic injection molding business in Pompano Beach, Florida, that has operated locally for more than 50 years. Its services cover plastic injection molding, mold production, part development, ultrasonic welding, and repair and maintenance of plastic molds, and it also uses 3D printing in its work. The company produces plastic parts for industrial, medical, construction and automotive applications, from prototypes through full production runs, and serves customers in Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade counties.
about:
American Plastic Molds operates from Pompano Beach, Florida, where it has served the South Florida region for more than 50 years. The company describes itself as a locally established plastic molding business that has continuously adapted new methods and technologies since its founding, though no specific year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The shop provides plastic injection molding, mold production, part development, ultrasonic welding, mold repair and maintenance, and 3D printing. It works with materials such as ABS, PVC, and PET, and runs ultrasonic plastic welding machines that join parts without adhesives or solvents. No facility square footage, headcount, annual volume, or part-number count is published.

The company produces components for industrial, medical, construction, and automotive applications, and its website also references electronics, high‑tech devices, and consumer goods. Its stated customer base spans Broward, Palm Beach, and Miami‑Dade counties, covering prototype through full‑production runs.

American Plastic Molds says it was started to deliver quality plastic products as quickly and efficiently as possible, emphasizing the speed and precision of ultrasonic welding as a differentiator that reduces cycle time, material waste, and time‑to‑market for complex assemblies.
built_on: Ultrasonic welding reduces manufacturing time versus adhesives or thermal welding
Ultrasonic machines weld ABS, PVC, PET and other plastics without consumables
In‑house mold repair and maintenance extends tool life
3D printing integrated for prototyping and fixture development
